findings.title: Clean-checkout v2 build cannot locate the tracked schema

source_evidence.observed_behavior: resolves people_schema_v2.sql beside the loader
the tracked schema is stored under schema/

findings.violated_invariant: The deterministic builder runs from a clean checkout using only tracked paths and supplied inputs.
findings.blast_radius: Every clean rebuild through build_people_graph_v2.py fails before reading input databases.

findings.title: v2 build silently merges source-native people by normalized display name

source_evidence.observed_behavior: maps whitespace-normalized lower-case names to existing person IDs before creating book people

findings.violated_invariant: Source observations stay separate until an explicit, evidenced identity decision is accepted.
findings.blast_radius: Same-labelled people from different domains can be fused and later edges attributed to the wrong row.

findings.title: Non-unique profile attributes are eligible for 0.98 identity auto-acceptance

source_evidence.observed_behavior: treats every external_ids platform/value pair as shared_external_id evidence at 0.98
stores real_name, company, and location in external_ids

findings.violated_invariant: Only identifier schemes with documented uniqueness semantics can resolve identity automatically.
findings.blast_radius: People sharing an employer, city, or common real name can receive accepted same-person claims.
findings.suggested_owning_lane: identity evidence policy and identifier registry

findings.title: Accepted identity claims are inert in canonical reads

source_evidence.observed_behavior: does not consult identity_claim or merged_into
stores accepted status without a canonical read projection

findings.violated_invariant: An accepted identity decision changes canonical query behavior or provides an explicit redirect/cluster.
findings.blast_radius: Queries still return duplicate people and partial work sets after a claim is accepted.

findings.title: Identity matcher reruns duplicate claims

source_evidence.observed_behavior: has no uniqueness constraint over a canonical person pair
uses INSERT OR IGNORE without a pair conflict key

findings.violated_invariant: A source-equivalent matcher rerun produces the same claim set.
findings.blast_radius: Review queues and counts grow on every rerun.

findings.title: Loaders are additive rather than source-replaceable

source_evidence.observed_behavior: adds a derived rating to rank_score on every applied run
never removes or tombstones source rows that disappear
reuses an output DB without clearing people or edges removed from source

findings.violated_invariant: Reruns are idempotent, and replaced sources cannot leave stale observations asserted as current.
findings.blast_radius: Ratings inflate; transferred/deleted repository edges and removed book rows survive.
findings.suggested_owning_lane: loader run provenance, replacement semantics, and idempotency

findings.title: GitHub enrichment overwrites canonical fields and blocks partial refresh

source_evidence.observed_behavior: updates name, kind, rank_score, and built_at from one API response
skips a person when any one of real_name, x_handle, or website already exists

findings.violated_invariant: Enrichment appends source-scoped observations and refreshes each missing field independently.
findings.blast_radius: Canonical labels, rank semantics, and build metadata can change; incomplete profiles can remain skipped.
findings.suggested_owning_lane: GitHub enrichment observations and refresh policy

findings.title: Topics and enrichment do not follow GitHub identity to non-gh canonical IDs

source_evidence.observed_behavior: discovers only person_id LIKE gh:% and constructs gh:<login> targets
selects only origin=github and treats person.name as the login

findings.violated_invariant: Domain adapters resolve through external identifiers and write to the canonical person regardless of prefix or origin.
findings.blast_radius: A canonical registry/book person with github_login can miss GitHub topics and enrichment.
findings.suggested_owning_lane: canonical ID adapters for GitHub loaders

findings.title: Book identity keys collapse distinct non-Latin names

source_evidence.observed_behavior: removes every character outside ASCII a-z, digits, comma, and space before using the result as an identity key

findings.violated_invariant: Unicode labels remain lossless observations and lossy comparison keys never become canonical IDs.
findings.blast_radius: Distinct non-Latin contributors can collapse into one person with combined attribution edges.

findings.title: Retained book aliases are discarded before FTS population

source_evidence.observed_behavior: stores raw_variants in the book people DB
populates person_search.aliases with an empty string

findings.violated_invariant: Every preserved source label is searchable without replacing the canonical display label.
findings.blast_radius: Pseudonyms, inverted forms, and known alternate labels can be present but unreachable by name lookup.
findings.suggested_owning_lane: FTS alias projection and search behavior

findings.title: GitHub login changes and repository transfers split identity despite stored numeric IDs

source_evidence.observed_behavior: records github_id as the stable account identifier
matches only github_login or gh:<login> and keys edges by current full_name

findings.violated_invariant: Stable platform IDs preserve one account across rename and source replacement reconciles transfers.
findings.blast_radius: One account can become multiple people while both old and new ownership assertions remain active.
findings.suggested_owning_lane: GitHub stable-ID ingest and ownership observation history

findings.title: Name candidates ignore human, organisation, and pseudonym conflicts

source_evidence.observed_behavior: does not load or gate on person.kind when creating name candidates

findings.violated_invariant: Known kind conflicts are negative evidence or a separately modelled relationship.
findings.blast_radius: Human-looking organisations and pseudonyms enter the ordinary same-person review queue without a conflict flag.
findings.suggested_owning_lane: identity candidate constraints and pseudonym modelling

findings.title: rank_score mixes and overwrites incompatible units

source_evidence.observed_behavior: uses book work_count as rank_score
uses summed repository stars as rank_score
adds mean repository rating to rank_score
overwrites rank_score with followers

findings.violated_invariant: Stored observations have named units; any rank is a documented projection over compatible evidence.
findings.blast_radius: Ordering depends on which loader ran last and cannot be interpreted across origins.
findings.suggested_owning_lane: evidence metrics and derived ranking projections

findings.title: v_contemporaries turns unknown death into birth+80

source_evidence.observed_behavior: uses COALESCE(death_year, birth_year + 80) in filtering and overlap_end

findings.violated_invariant: Unknown temporal bounds remain qualified uncertainty and do not create an unlabelled certain edge.
findings.blast_radius: People can be returned as contemporaries solely because an 80-year lifespan was substituted.
findings.suggested_owning_lane: temporal evidence and uncertainty-aware query views

findings.title: Missing-domain results look like evidence-backed empty results

source_evidence.observed_behavior: returns empty matches when people is absent and reports only present domains

findings.violated_invariant: Capability absence is distinguished from a valid query that found no evidence.
findings.blast_radius: Agents can infer that no person exists when the people database is simply unavailable.
findings.suggested_owning_lane: query capability diagnostics and inventory contract

findings.title: Pinned Book Library export silently merges names and drops non-author roles

source_evidence.observed_behavior: reuses canonical IDs by normalized display name and exports only AUTHORSHIP={author}
preserves distinct roles when supplied in bkp.person_work; PGRT-T022 confirms this invariant

findings.violated_invariant: Cross-repository exports preserve source identity boundaries and every contributor role until explicit resolution.
findings.blast_radius: Distinct same-named book people can be fused and translator/editor attribution can disappear upstream.
findings.suggested_owning_lane: siso-book-library export contract plus People Graph ingest seam
